title: Libra, 500 CFA francs, Zodiac signs
descriptionPlain: Description Libra is an air sign that symbolizes harmony, diplomacy, and an innate sense of justice. People born under this sign captivate with grace, value beauty, and seek balance in every area of life. A silver coin featuring Libra pays tribute to those who look for agreement and calm in relationships, and in a collection it reminds us of the power of partnership and aesthetics.
